assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit helm tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit helm tip body
en: [You fly the destroyer. The radar shows space around you — up is always your heading. Your flight controls are on the right.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — flight-stick tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — flight-stick tip body
en: [Drag the flight stick: push up to thrust, pull sideways to steer. The ship holds your last input until you move it again.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — lateral-thrust tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — lateral-thrust tip body
en: [The lower stick slides the ship sideways without turning — dodge incoming fire or drift across an enemy's aim.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — impulse-drive tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — impulse-drive tip body
en: [Impulse charges up and then hurls the ship forward in a burst. Press to start charging; press again to cancel.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — boost-ready contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — boost-ready contextual tip body
en: [Boost is charged. Hold the boost button for a burst of speed — the battery drains while it runs and recharges after.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert contextual tip body
en: [Hostile weapon arcs now paint onto your radar. Keep the ship out of the shaded wedges while Tactical returns fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit captain tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit captain tip body
en: [You command the destroyer. Read the sensor scope, point the viewscreen, keep the crew's objectives straight, and call Red Alert when it's time to fight.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — viewscreen-camera tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — viewscreen-camera tip body
en: [Switch the main viewscreen between camera angles so the crew sees what matters most right now.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — sensor-scan tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — sensor-scan tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the sensor scope to scan it — its class, heading and shield strength appear below.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — objectives tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — objectives tip body
en: [Boost an objective's priority to flag it for the crew as the current focus.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-authority tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-authority tip body
en: [Only you can call it. Red Alert arms the crew's weapons and puts hostile firing arcs on Helm's radar.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-active contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-active contextual tip body
en: [The ship is armed and hostile arcs are live on Helm's radar. Watch Sensors for threat details while the crew fights.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit tactical tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit tactical tip body
en: [You run the destroyer's guns. Lock a target on the radar, then work the omni phaser, forward blasters and torpedo tubes to bring it down — and keep an ear on Comms for orders.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — target-lock tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — target-lock tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the radar to lock it as your target. Blasters and torpedoes need a lock before they'll fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — omni-phaser tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — omni-phaser tip body
en: [The phaser fires in every direction and needs no lock. Toggle Auto/Manual, or press Fire yourself in Manual mode.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — forward-blasters tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — forward-blasters tip body
en: [Port and starboard blasters cover a narrow forward arc. Hold Fire to charge a volley, release to launch it.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — torpedo-tubes tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — torpedo-tubes tip body
en: [Fore and aft tubes load automatically. Use +/- to set how many rounds to hold loaded, then press Fire to launch them at your locked target.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — comms-overlay tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — comms-overlay tip body
en: [Open Comms to hail contacts and read incoming messages — the badge lights up when something new comes in.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit engineering tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit engineering tip body
en: [You keep the destroyer alive. Balance reactor power between Helm, Weapons and Sensors, focus shields toward incoming fire, and send repair teams to anything that's hurting.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — power-allocation tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — power-allocation tip body
en: [Use +/- to shift reactor power between groups. Pull power from what you don't need to push more into what you do.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — shield-focus tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — shield-focus tip body
en: [Focus an arc to boost its regen against the bearing you're taking fire from — every other arc regens slower while it's focused.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — repair-teams tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — repair-teams tip body
en: [Dispatch a team to a damaged system to start repairs. A team already on a job can be given priority over the others.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — hull-damage contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — hull-damage contextual tip body
en: [Something on the ship just took a hit. Check which system is hurting and get a repair team moving before it fails outright.]

en: [You set the ship's posture. Coordinate the crew and call the shots — no one else has the full picture.]

context: Help modal — captain station, section 2 heading

en: [Raises ship-wide combat readiness. Call it before entering a fight, not after taking the first hit.]

context: Help modal — captain station, section 3 heading

en: [Keep the main screen camera updated so the whole bridge sees what matters right now.]

en: [Keep the ship moving and the target in arc for Tactical. You control where the fight happens.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 2 heading

en: [Drag to accelerate, reverse, or steer. WASD or the arrow keys steer too, as does a gamepad stick.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 3 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 3 body text
en: [10× speed burst for rapid travel. Damage cancels it, so it's best for non-combat travel. Press Ctrl or gamepad B to charge, again to cancel.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 4 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 4 body text
en: [Hold Shift or gamepad A for 3× speed while the battery lasts. It drains in a few seconds and takes far longer to refill, so save it for closing a gap.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 5 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 5 body text
en: [Push your radar to the viewscreen when someone needs to see your situation.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 1 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 1 body text
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 body text
en: [Lock first — phasers and torpedoes both require an active lock by clicking on the target.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 3 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 3 body text
en: [Fast and continuous but arc-limited. Enable Auto so they fire the instant the target crosses your fire arc.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 4 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 4 body text
en: [Use them when on priority target. They do less damage to shields than hull, sensors can monitor target shields.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 1 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 1 body text
en: [Keep the ship in the fight. Damaged systems degrade everyone's performance — act early.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 2 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 2 body text
en: [Your ship health gauge, it doesn't show where the damage is, the other bridge officers should ask for repairs.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 3 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 3 body text
en: [Dispatch teams to damaged consoles, sooner rather than later.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 1 heading
Help modal — power station, section 1 body text
en: [You decide how much performance each system gets. Shift allocations as the battle changes.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 2 heading

en: [Distribute 6 base points across systems. Higher level means better performance from that station.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 3 heading
Help modal — power station, section 3 body text
en: [Holds up to 2 emergency power points. Let it drain completely and everyone gets locked out for a time.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 1 heading

en: [Absorb incoming fire and keep the ship alive.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 2 heading
Help modal — shields station, section 2 body text

Help modal — shields station, section 3 body text
en: [Concentrate capacity on one facing to tank heavy fire by tapping it. Tap again to rebalance shields]

context: Help modal — sensors station, section 2 heading

en: [Detect contacts before they enter combat range and provides some extra information on their status]

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 3 heading

en: [Abort an active impulse charge if Helm is about to overshoot or fly into a hazard.]

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 4 heading
Help modal — navigation station, section 4 body text
en: [Tap a contact on the chart to select it, then "Set as Waypoint" to mark it as the destination. "Set Waypoint" lets you place a destination anywhere on the map, and "Clear Waypoint" removes it.]

context: Help modal — comms station, section 1 heading
Help modal — comms station, section 1 body text
en: [Connect the ship to the outside world. You are the first to know about orders, threats, and opportunities.]

Help modal — comms station, section 3 body text
